## 3. Handler Layer — Implementations (Precise — file reads)

### 3.1 `ConfigHandler`
[`Handler/ConfigHandler.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs)

Single static class. Owns the full lifecycle of `guiNConfig.json`.

**Public API surface (all `public static`):**

| Method | Key behaviour |
|---|---|
| `LoadConfig(ref Config)` | Deserialise JSON; apply defaults; call `LazyConfig.Instance.SetConfig` |
| `SaveConfig(ref Config, bool)` | Set `Global.reloadV2ray`; delegate to `ToJsonFile` |
| `AddServer` / `AddShadowsocksServer` / `AddSocksServer` / `AddTrojanServer` / `AddVlessServer` | Type-specific validation then `AddServerCommon` |
| `AddCustomServer` | File-copy to config path; detect core type from content heuristics |
| `AddBatchServers(ref Config, string, string, string)` | Public entry point; tries raw → Base64 → SsSIP008 → Custom pipelines |
| `RemoveServer` / `RemoveServerViaSubid` | Calls private `RemoveVmessItem`; handles `Custom` file deletion |
| `SetDefaultServer` / `GetDefaultServer` | Manages `config.indexId` |
| `MoveServer` | Sort-field manipulation with `EMove` enum |
| `SortServers` | LINQ `OrderBy`/`OrderByDescending` via `QueryableExtension` |
| `DedupServerList` | Uses private `CompareVmessItem`; respects `config.keepOlderDedupl` |
| `SaveSubItem` / `AddSubItem` / `RemoveServerViaSubid` | Subscription management |
| `SaveGroupItem` / `RemoveGroupItem` / `MoveServerToGroup` | Group management |
| `SaveRouting` / `AddRoutingItem` / `AddBatchRoutingRules` / `MoveRoutingRule` | Routing rule management |
| `InitBuiltinRouting` | Seeds three built-in presets (white/black/global) + one locked rule from embedded resources |
| `GetLockedRoutingItem` | Returns the single `locked==true` item |
| `UpgradeServerVersion` | Migrates `configVersion<2` ws/h2 `requestHost` splitting |

**Write path invariant:** every write goes through private `ToJsonFile`, which uses a temp-file-then-rename pattern under `objLock` to prevent corruption.

**`AddBatchServers4Custom` heuristic dispatch** (search-based — no formal content-type header):
- Contains `inbounds`+`outbounds` JSON keys → `ECoreType.Xray`
- Contains `port`+`socks-port`+`proxies` → `ECoreType.clash`
- Contains `server`+`up`+`down`+`listen` (no HTML) → `ECoreType.hysteria`
- Contains `listen`+`proxy` (no HTML) → `ECoreType.naiveproxy`

### 3.2 `V2rayConfigHandler`
[`Handler/V2rayConfigHandler.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/V2rayConfigHandler.cs)

Generates the runtime `config.json` that is passed to the core process.

**Public API:**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `GenerateClientConfig(VmessItem, fileName, out msg, out content)` | Dispatch: Custom → `GenerateClientCustomConfig`; others → `GenerateClientConfigContent` |
| `GenerateClientConfigContent(VmessItem, blExport, ref V2rayConfig, out msg)` | Orchestrates: `log` → `inbound` → `routing` → `outbound` → `dns` → `statistic` |
| `GenerateClientSpeedtestConfigString(Config, List<ServerTestItem>, out msg)` | Builds a multi-inbound/multi-outbound config for parallel speed-testing |
| `GenerateServerConfig` | Builds a server-side (inbound) config |
| `ImportFromClientConfig` / `ImportFromServerConfig` | Parse existing JSON back to `VmessItem` |
| `Export2ClientConfig` / `Export2ServerConfig` | Thin wrappers for file export |

**`GenerateClientCustomConfig`** modifies Clash YAML configs in-place by patching `port:` and `socks-port:` lines to match the GUI's configured local ports — a text-line-level mutation on YAML.

**`statistic` method** adds `StatsService` API inbound on `Global.statePort` (a runtime-assigned global) and injects a routing rule to direct API traffic away from the proxy outbound.

### 3.3 `LazyConfig`
[`Handler/LazyConfig.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/LazyConfig.cs)

Singleton (thread-safe `Lazy<T>`). Holds the single live `Config` instance. Provides:
- `SetConfig` / `GetConfig` — registry for the singleton `Config`
- `GetShadowsocksSecuritys(VmessItem)` — returns per-core security list
- `GetCoreType(VmessItem, EConfigType)` — `VmessItem.coreType` override first, then `Config.coreTypeItem` lookup, default `ECoreType.Xray`
- `GetCoreInfo(ECoreType)` — lazy-initialise and lookup `coreInfos`
- `InitCoreInfo()` — hardcoded registry of 11 supported cores: `v2fly`, `SagerNet`, `v2fly_v5`, `Xray`, `clash`, `clash_meta`, `hysteria`, `naiveproxy`, `tuic`, `sing_box`, `v2rayN`

### 3.4 `ShareHandler`
[`Handler/ShareHandler.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ShareHandler.cs)

Serialise/deserialise server share URLs. All protocol schemes are dispatched by URI prefix:

| Prefix | Parser | Emitter |
|---|---|---|
| `vmess://` | `ResolveVmess` (base64-JSON) or `ResolveStdVmess` (if `?` present) or `ResolveVmess4Kitsunebi` | `ShareVmess` |
| `ss://` | `ResolveSSLegacy` (Regex) or `ResolveSip002` | `ShareShadowsocks` (SIP002 format) |
| `socks://` | `ResolveSocksNew` or `ResolveSocks` (base64) | `ShareSocks` |
| `trojan://` | `ResolveTrojan` + `ResolveStdTransport` | `ShareTrojan` |
| `vless://` | `ResolveStdVLESS` + `ResolveStdTransport` | `ShareVLESS` |

Transport parameters (flow, sni, alpn, network type, path, host, headerType, seed, serviceName, mode) are canonicalised through `GetStdTransport` (emit) / `ResolveStdTransport` (parse). `ResolveStdTransport` is shared between Trojan and VLESS parsers.

### 3.5 `V2rayHandler`
[`Handler/V2rayHandler.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/V2rayHandler.cs)

Process lifecycle manager. `ProcessDelegate` event carries log messages to the UI.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `LoadV2ray(Config)` | If `Global.reloadV2ray`: get default server → `SetCore` → `GenerateClientConfig` → `V2rayRestart`; optionally starts a socks pre-proxy process for `Custom`+`preSocksPort>0` configs |
| `LoadV2rayConfigString` | Generates speed-test multi-config string and passes via stdin to new process (`-config stdin:`) |
| `V2rayStop` / `V2rayStopPid` | Kills managed process; falls back to `Process.GetProcessesByName` scan |
| `V2rayStart` | Starts via `ProcessStartInfo`, optionally redirects stdout/stderr; registers handle with `Global.processJob` (Win32 Job Object for child process cleanup) |
| `SetCore` | Calls `LazyConfig.Instance.GetCoreType` → `LazyConfig.Instance.GetCoreInfo` to select the binary |

`V2rayFindexe` iterates `coreInfo.coreExes` list and returns the first matching `.exe` in the startup path; reports missing core URL on failure.

## 5. Public API Boundaries (Precise)

The application has **no network-facing API**. The public API boundary is the GUI surface:

- **Inbound to core:** `config.json` (generated by `V2rayConfigHandler.GenerateClientConfig`) written to the application startup directory, then read by the external core process
- **Outbound stats from core:** gRPC `StatsService` on `Global.statePort` (loopback only), consumed by `StatisticsHandler`
- **Share/import URL:** the URI schemes (`vmess://`, `vless://`, `ss://`, `trojan://`, `socks://`) are the cross-application data exchange format; handled by `ShareHandler`
- **Subscription fetch:** HTTP GET of a URL stored in `SubItem.url`, returning base64-encoded server list; fetched by `DownloadHandle`

## 10. Key Architectural Observations

1. **`VmessItem` is a God Object.** It carries fields for all six `EConfigType` values simultaneously; fields like `alterId` are VMess-only, `flow`/`sni`/`alpn`/`fingerprint` are VLESS/TLS-specific. This is a design smell that makes `CompareVmessItem` fragile across types (note the explicit `o.configType == EConfigType.Trojan` carve-out for `streamSecurity` comparison at line 817).

2. **`Global.reloadV2ray` is a mutable global flag** written from many sites and read in `V2rayHandler.LoadV2ray`. Race conditions are possible if UI actions and background timers trigger concurrent writes, though the main form is likely single-threaded WinForms.

3. **`ToJsonFile` temp-rename pattern** (line 217–228 of `ConfigHandler.cs`) is the only crash-safety mechanism for the config file. There is no backup rotation.

4. **Core type selection is per-entry.** `VmessItem.coreType` (nullable) overrides the global `Config.coreTypeItem` lookup, which in turn overrides the hardcoded default of `ECoreType.Xray`. This three-layer fallback is entirely in `LazyConfig.GetCoreType`.

5. **Clash YAML port patching** in `GenerateClientCustomConfig` (lines 970–983) is line-index-based text mutation: it `FindIndex(t => t.Contains("port:"))` and removes the first match. This is fragile to YAML ordering and would break if a comment line contains the word `port:`.

## 3. Handler Layer — Implementations (Precise — file reads)

### 3.1 `ConfigHandler`
[`Handler/ConfigHandler.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs)

Single static class. Owns the full lifecycle of `guiNConfig.json`.

**Public API surface (all `public static`):**

| Method | Key behaviour |
|---|---|
| `LoadConfig(ref Config)` | Deserialise JSON; apply defaults; call `LazyConfig.Instance.SetConfig` |
| `SaveConfig(ref Config, bool)` | Set `Global.reloadV2ray`; delegate to `ToJsonFile` |
| `AddServer` / `AddShadowsocksServer` / `AddSocksServer` / `AddTrojanServer` / `AddVlessServer` | Type-specific validation then `AddServerCommon` |
| `AddCustomServer` | File-copy to config path; detect core type from content heuristics |
| `AddBatchServers(ref Config, string, string, string)` | Public entry point; tries raw → Base64 → SsSIP008 → Custom pipelines |
| `RemoveServer` / `RemoveServerViaSubid` | Calls private `RemoveVmessItem`; handles `Custom` file deletion |
| `SetDefaultServer` / `GetDefaultServer` | Manages `config.indexId` |
| `MoveServer` | Sort-field manipulation with `EMove` enum |
| `SortServers` | LINQ `OrderBy`/`OrderByDescending` via `QueryableExtension` |
| `DedupServerList` | Uses private `CompareVmessItem`; respects `config.keepOlderDedupl` |
| `SaveSubItem` / `AddSubItem` / `RemoveServerViaSubid` | Subscription management |
| `SaveGroupItem` / `RemoveGroupItem` / `MoveServerToGroup` | Group management |
| `SaveRouting` / `AddRoutingItem` / `AddBatchRoutingRules` / `MoveRoutingRule` | Routing rule management |
| `InitBuiltinRouting` | Seeds three built-in presets (white/black/global) + one locked rule from embedded resources |
| `GetLockedRoutingItem` | Returns the single `locked==true` item |
| `UpgradeServerVersion` | Migrates `configVersion<2` ws/h2 `requestHost` splitting |

**Write path invariant:** every write goes through private `ToJsonFile`, which uses a temp-file-then-rename pattern under `objLock` to prevent corruption.

**`AddBatchServers4Custom` heuristic dispatch** (search-based — no formal content-type header):
- Contains `inbounds`+`outbounds` JSON keys → `ECoreType.Xray`
- Contains `port`+`socks-port`+`proxies` → `ECoreType.clash`
- Contains `server`+`up`+`down`+`listen` (no HTML) → `ECoreType.hysteria`
- Contains `listen`+`proxy` (no HTML) → `ECoreType.naiveproxy`

### 3.2 `V2rayConfigHandler`
[`Handler/V2rayConfigHandler.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/V2rayConfigHandler.cs)

### 3.3 `LazyConfig`
[`Handler/LazyConfig.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/LazyConfig.cs)

- `SetConfig` / `GetConfig` — registry for the singleton `Config`
- `GetShadowsocksSecuritys(VmessItem)` — returns per-core security list
- `GetCoreType(VmessItem, EConfigType)` — `VmessItem.coreType` override first, then `Config.coreTypeItem` lookup, default `ECoreType.Xray`

### 3.4 `ShareHandler`
[`Handler/ShareHandler.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ShareHandler.cs)

Serialise/deserialise server share URLs. All protocol schemes are dispatched by URI prefix:

| Prefix | Parser | Emitter |
|---|---|---|
| `vmess://` | `ResolveVmess` (base64-JSON) or `ResolveStdVmess` (if `?` present) or `ResolveVmess4Kitsunebi` | `ShareVmess` |
| `ss://` | `ResolveSSLegacy` (Regex) or `ResolveSip002` | `ShareShadowsocks` (SIP002 format) |
| `socks://` | `ResolveSocksNew` or `ResolveSocks` (base64) | `ShareSocks` |
| `trojan://` | `ResolveTrojan` + `ResolveStdTransport` | `ShareTrojan` |
| `vless://` | `ResolveStdVLESS` + `ResolveStdTransport` | `ShareVLESS` |

Transport parameters (flow, sni, alpn, network type, path, host, headerType, seed, serviceName, mode) are canonicalised through `GetStdTransport` (emit) / `ResolveStdTransport` (parse). `ResolveStdTransport` is shared between Trojan and VLESS parsers.

[`Handler/V2rayHandler.cs`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/V2rayHandler.cs)

Process lifecycle manager. `ProcessDelegate` event carries log messages to the UI.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `LoadV2ray(Config)` | If `Global.reloadV2ray`: get default server → `SetCore` → `GenerateClientConfig` → `V2rayRestart`; optionally starts a socks pre-proxy process for `Custom`+`preSocksPort>0` configs |
| `LoadV2rayConfigString` | Generates speed-test multi-config string and passes via stdin to new process (`-config stdin:`) |
| `V2rayStop` / `V2rayStopPid` | Kills managed process; falls back to `Process.GetProcessesByName` scan |
| `V2rayStart` | Starts via `ProcessStartInfo`, optionally redirects stdout/stderr; registers handle with `Global.processJob` (Win32 Job Object for child process cleanup) |
| `SetCore` | Calls `LazyConfig.Instance.GetCoreType` → `LazyConfig.Instance.GetCoreInfo` to select the binary |

`V2rayFindexe` iterates `coreInfo.coreExes` list and returns the first matching `.exe` in the startup path; reports missing core URL on failure.

## 5. Public API Boundaries (Precise)

The application has **no network-facing API**. The public API boundary is the GUI surface:

- **Inbound to core:** `config.json` (generated by `V2rayConfigHandler.GenerateClientConfig`) written to the application startup directory, then read by the external core process
- **Outbound stats from core:** gRPC `StatsService` on `Global.statePort` (loopback only), consumed by `StatisticsHandler`
- **Share/import URL:** the URI schemes (`vmess://`, `vless://`, `ss://`, `trojan://`, `socks://`) are the cross-application data exchange format; handled by `ShareHandler`
- **Subscription fetch:** HTTP GET of a URL stored in `SubItem.url`, returning base64-encoded server list; fetched by `DownloadHandle`

## 10. Key Architectural Observations

1. **`VmessItem` is a God Object.** It carries fields for all six `EConfigType` values simultaneously; fields like `alterId` are VMess-only, `flow`/`sni`/`alpn`/`fingerprint` are VLESS/TLS-specific. This is a design smell that makes `CompareVmessItem` fragile across types (note the explicit `o.configType == EConfigType.Trojan` carve-out for `streamSecurity` comparison at line 817).

2. **`Global.reloadV2ray` is a mutable global flag** written from many sites and read in `V2rayHandler.LoadV2ray`. Race conditions are possible if UI actions and background timers trigger concurrent writes, though the main form is likely single-threaded WinForms.

3. **`ToJsonFile` temp-rename pattern** (line 217–228 of `ConfigHandler.cs`) is the only crash-safety mechanism for the config file. There is no backup rotation.

4. **Core type selection is per-entry.** `VmessItem.coreType` (nullable) overrides the global `Config.coreTypeItem` lookup, which in turn overrides the hardcoded default of `ECoreType.Xray`. This three-layer fallback is entirely in `LazyConfig.GetCoreType`.

5. **Clash YAML port patching** in `GenerateClientCustomConfig` (lines 970–983) is line-index-based text mutation: it `FindIndex(t => t.Contains("port:"))` and removes the first match. This is fragile to YAML ordering and would break if a comment line contains the word `port:`.
